title: Coefficient automorphisms and change of the kernel trace
statement: Given finite coefficients A, a proper q:X → Y, a complex B on X, and a trace-diagonal datum D on B [lem-sf-diagonal-kernel-integral-triangles], let a be an automorphism of B and let τ:Rq_! B → the derived tensor unit satisfy Rq_!(a) followed by D.trace = τ. The explicitly constructed datum kernelDatumWithTrace D τ retains the diagonal class and has trace τ. For every K on Y, applying Rq_! to the tensor action of a and then the kernel counit of D is equal to the kernel counit of the new datum. This is an equality of counit composites and does not assert either triangle identity.

source.place: The coefficient normalization and transport of the kernel counit in the diagonal argument.

proof.text: Construct the new datum with trace τ and with the diagonal class of D. Its trace projection is τ by the record constructor. Naturality of the projection map in B gives the square for the coefficient automorphism. Cancel the projection isomorphism to obtain the square for its inverse, then use tensor functoriality and the hypothesis Rq_!(a) D.trace=τ. Both counit composites have the same final left-unitor factor.

proof_origin.place: The coefficient normalization and transport of the kernel counit in the diagonal argument.

theorem kernelCounit_traceChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q]
    (B : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (D : TraceDiagonalDatum A q B) (a : B ≅ B)
    (τ : (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).obj B ⟶
      derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y)
    (hτ : (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).map a.hom ≫ D.trace = τ) :
    let D' := kernelDatumWithTrace A q B D τ
    D'.trace = τ ∧ ∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).map
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).map a.hom).app
            ((CoordinateTrace.pull A q).obj K)) ≫ (SfDiagonalKernel.counit A D).app K =
        (SfDiagonalKernel.counit A D').app K
